coverage: LLVM source coverage in the pinned GPAC ISO media parser (src/isomedia), built as a static ISO-media-only libgpac and called through gf_isom_open on a local file from a C byte-input harness
parser_family: GPAC native ISO media parser; the C++ call site (adapters/cpp/mp4/gpac.cpp) compiles this same C call site as C++, and MP4Box is a CLI over the same libgpac, so they are one parser family, not independent engines
